name: Barbell Back Squat
grip: Closed grip outside the shoulders to secure the bar on the upper back; the hands do not carry the bar overhead.
description: Squat with a barbell supported on the upper back, bending the knees and hips while keeping the feet planted.
setup: Set the rack and safety supports to suit your height and planned depth.
Place the bar across the upper trapezius below the neck, grasp it securely and stand clear of the hooks.
Choose a stable stance around shoulder-width, with the toes turned out as comfortable.
instructions: Brace the trunk and lower by bending the knees and hips together.
Keep the whole foot loaded and knees tracking in the direction of the toes.
Descend to a depth you can control; the drawing shows thighs around parallel.
Drive through the feet to stand, then rerack securely after the set.
cues: Stand with chest and hips rising together.
commonMistakes: Lifting the heels or collapsing the knees inward.
Losing trunk control to force extra depth.

logging.example: A 20 kg bar plus two 15 kg plates: record 50 kg total.
